narrative.summary: Grenada has no AI-specific law, strategy or guidance. Its only relevant instrument is the general Data Protection Act, 2023, which governs the personal data used by AI systems but has not yet been brought into force. AI appears only as a stated focus of the government's Division of ICT and the new Digital Transformation Agency.
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026 from the official laws portal, Parliament's website and the government portal. The official gazette's search could not be used, and 2026 Acts after No. 5 are not yet online. The Division of ICT's automation and ICT policies, whose texts are not published, are tracked as leads.

instruments.issuing_authority: Parliament of Grenada (House of Representatives and Senate); assented to by the Deputy Governor-General
instruments.publisher_name: Government of Grenada (Laws of Grenada portal; printed by the Government Printer)
instruments.scope: Personal data processed by public and private bodies in Grenada (national)
instruments.summary: Grenada's first general data protection law applies to personal data processed by public and private bodies, including data processed wholly or partly by automatic equipment, and sets seven privacy and data protection principles (general, notice and choice, disclosure, security, retention, data integrity and access). It gives data subjects rights of access and rectification, restricts processing of sensitive personal data, and establishes an Information Commission with complaint-investigation, information-notice, enforcement-notice and search powers, backed by offences and penalties. It contains no AI-specific or automated-decision provisions, but governs personal data used to train and run AI systems once in force.
instruments.current_status: Passed by the House of Representatives on 14 March 2023 and the Senate on 6 April 2023; assented to on 9 May 2023; dated 10 May 2023 and printed by the Government Printer on 10/5/2023. Section 1(2) provides that the Act comes into operation on a day appointed by the Minister (the Minister responsible for National Security) by Order in the Gazette. No commencement order was found in the Statutory Rules and Orders listed on the Laws of Grenada portal for 2023-2026 (checked 2026-10-12), so the Act is recorded as adopted but not yet in force.

leads.title: Digital Transformation Agency Act, 2026 (Act No. 10 of 2026)
leads.note: Bill published on the Parliament site (https://grenadaparliament.gd/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Digital-Transformation-Agency-Bill-2026-1.pdf, read 2026-10-12): creates a Digital Transformation Agency to lead and coordinate digital transformation across public bodies, which must follow its directives, codes, standards and guidelines. The bill text contains no AI provisions, so it fails the scope test. Reported as assented to on 31 August 2026 (news only); the Act is not yet on the Laws of Grenada portal (2026 Acts listed only to No. 5). Re-check if the Agency issues AI standards or guidelines.
